_comment: Figures in content/positions.md that the build's cross-check (figures.py) could not tie to a published sentence about the same thing, accepted on purpose after a person read the cited source. `figure` is the key check_figures.py prints. A reason is required. Entries here were checked against the cited text by Claude on 2026-10-21 as a draft; staff confirm them at sign-off.

allow.reason: "A family of four with two young children would have to earn over $107,000 to stay above the ALICE threshold". The position says about $107,000 is needed to cover living costs.
